correctness.rationale: Two elementary full-rank two-column character sums yield exact rank-one and rank-two Gram entries. Orthogonal contrast/rook/constant-mode diagonalization produces the complete multiset; the variance argument and an explicit row-contrast formula prove strict positivity. Exact rational factorization of the endpoint comparison proves the strict m=2q transition. All quantifiers m>=3 and prime power q>=2 are handled by algebra; checker enumeration over eight fields and 576 exact rational comparisons is corroborative.

value.rationale: Conditioning the canonical coordinate Fourier band on matrix invertibility asks for precise loss of orthogonality and stability of inverse Fourier measurements on a natural full-rank variety. The theorem yields complete sharp bounds and equality spaces in every dimension >=3, and discovers a strict, exact arithmetic crossover of the upper extremizer at m=2q, with uniform asymptotic stability rates. This is a motivated structural classification rather than a small-case calculation or a generic rank-orbit table.
